policy: Published standard results are explicit proposition inputs. No external result is installed as a Lean axiom; no paper-specific missing proof is exempted.

dependencies.name: PUT.External.DirichletJointMomentLaw
dependencies.statement: For d >= 2 and a > 0, the actual normalized-independent-Gamma Dirichlet measure has integrable integer monomials and integral equal to the quotient of rising factorials.

references.title: NIST DLMF 5.14.2, multivariate beta simplex integral
Anirban DasGupta, Graduate Probability, Section 1.23, Theorem 1.68, printed pp. 138-139

dependencies.specialization: The normalized-Gamma identification and shifted multivariate beta integrals give the stated symmetric joint moments.

dependencies.name: PUT.External.NinefoldAmplificationLaw
dependencies.statement: Nine independent coherent repetitions and majority voting transform every finite-workspace tester family into one using exactly 9Q calls, with each promised error at most 2^9*(1/100)^5.

references.title: John Watrous, Quantum Computational Complexity, Sections III.3 and IV.2, Proposition 3 and following discussion

dependencies.specialization: This is the nine-run specialization of the standard repetition construction, not a claim that Proposition 3 literally states 9Q. The elementary numerical error bound is proved in TestingLowerBound.

dependencies.name: PUT.External.KutinCollisionLaw
dependencies.statement: There is a positive absolute kappa such that every standard additive-function-query algorithm distinguishing injections from four-to-one functions [D] -> [D], for positive D divisible by 4, with error at most 1/3 uses at least kappa*(D/4)^(1/3) queries.

references.title: Samuel Kutin, Quantum lower bound for the collision problem with small range, Theory of Computing 1 (2005), Theorem 1.1, p.30; additive query model Section 2.1

dependencies.specialization: r=4. The actual P24 reduction, complete unknown unitaries, inverse/control access, arbitrary finite workspace, 4Q standard-query cost and exact Born-output equality are proved internally.

dependencies.name: PUT.External.AdaptiveNormalizationLaw
dependencies.statement: Every finite adaptive projective-query tree with at most Q queries on each branch admits a unitary tester family using exactly 2Q fixed-direction controlled calls and preserving every valid full oracle's rejection probability, including outside the promise.

references.title: John Watrous, Quantum Computational Complexity, Section III.3 and Figure 5, unitary purification

dependencies.specialization: Deferred measurement with finite history registers and two slots (forward/inverse) per adaptive query depth, plus controlled padding for inactive and halted histories. The factor two is explicitly absorbed into the lower-bound constant. The finite adaptive syntax, its Born semantics and transfer of the lower bound are proved internally.

never_externalized: P24 full Fourier-Dirichlet query-norm estimate and its constant 20
P24 principal/radial decomposition on whole radial L2 sectors
P24 Holder, TV moment and Paley-Zygmund argument
Actual prior averaged rejection, adversary commutation and progress decrease
P24 collision preparation and complete controlled/inverse unitary simulation
Legal parameter cutoffs, actual Q inequality, small dimensions and finite qubit embeddings
